title: Jiwwu xeex bi
intro: Balaa àdduna bi di xam xeex bu tasaaroo, dafa am natt bu xóot ci ngëm ak déggal. Léeb bii dafay wax ci tànneef yi benn nit def, te jëfam dafay nekk royukaay ci mbokk yiy ñëw. Waajal nettali jaar-jaaru ruuh buy xeex ak fiiraange gu rëy ak jafe-jafe yi mu àndal.
clues: Maa ngi nekkoon ci doomi jëkkër ak jabar yi njëkka dundu ci kaw suuf.
Man ak sama mag danou digal nu jébbal Yallah sarax, muy natt sunu njub.
Sama sarax nangu wuñu ko, waaye sama rak nangu nañu ko, mu fees sama xol ak yëg-yëg bu metti.
Ma wax sama rak ay kàddu yuy tiital, ndax limu ma baña nangu.
Sama mbokk tontoo ko ak xel ak ragal Yàlla, fàttali ma njubteg Yàlla ak ragal ko.
Doonte sama rak daf ma wax lu woyof, ba noppi bëgga baale, ma jël sama bakkan, nekk kenn ci ñi ñàkk.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
